name: The Balance of Light and Shadow
label: Quest
description: The Balance of Light and Shadow: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You must do what I could not: Save the peasants that were cut down while fleeing from Stratholme.
They will walk towards the light, you must ensure their survival. Should too many fall, our cursed existence shall continue - you will have failed.
Every ability, prayer, and spell that you have learned will be tested. May the Light protect you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your tenacity and courage are astounding, priest. You have earned the right to hold the Splinter of Nordrassil. Only one task remains: The Eye of Shadow must be recovered. Scour the world.
